The registered discovery methods

Source: R/registry.R
list_methods.Rd

Returns every registered method as a cd_method list, or – with as_data_frame = TRUE – a data frame summarising the registry and which back-ends are installed in the current session.

Usage

list_methods(as_data_frame = TRUE, refresh = FALSE)

Arguments

as_data_frame

A single logical. When TRUE (the default) a data frame is returned; when FALSE a named list of cd_method objects.

refresh

A single logical. When TRUE, the session cache of Python back-end availability checks is discarded and the probes run again – use it after installing a Python module mid-session.

Value

A data frame with columns id, name, family, language, cost, accepts ("data" or "suffstat"), and installed, or a named list of cd_method objects.

Details

Python back-end availability is checked passively: cdzoo never initialises Python (which can trigger interpreter provisioning) just to report it. A Python back-end shows installed = TRUE once reticulate's interpreter is initialised or configured (for example via RETICULATE_PYTHON); set options(cdzoo.python_init = TRUE) to let this check initialise Python eagerly. Probe results are cached for the session.

See also

Other registry: cd_method(), register_method()
